The slice's value: prove the framework produces useful, calibrated, source-grounded output for one stock before paying engineering cost of scaling to 30+ stocks across 4 tiers and 9 BCs.\n\n## A.2 User & Use Cases\n\n**Primary user**: project owner (self-use). Phase 1 has no external users.\n\n- **UC-1: Ingest 1 year of VHM EOD bars** — `python apps/cli/ingest_vhm.py --start 2025-04-30 --end 2026-04-29 --output ./data/vhm.sqlite` → ≥200 daily Bar rows + reconciliation report.\n- **UC-2: Open Position with deterministic risk** — `Position(ticker=VHM, ..., risk_rule=RiskRule(max_pct=0.15))`; system enforces position-sizing in code (Charter Principle 10).\n- **UC-3: Compute current value and PnL** — `position.current_value(latest_bar)` returns Money in VND; `pnl_pct(...)` returns Decimal. All numbers from code, not LLM (Charter Principle 9).\n\n## A.3 Business Rules\n\n- **BR-1 Bar invariants** (I-S2 + I-S4): every `Bar` has `period_end ≤ today`, `filing_date ≤ today`, `adjustment_type ∈ {NONE,DIVIDEND,SPLIT,BOTH}`, `source_provider ∈ {VNSTOCK,TCBS,...}`. Construction without these raises.\n- **BR-2 Position deterministic risk**: `Position.is_violating_risk(portfolio_total)` returns from `RiskRule` constants; LLM cannot mutate `RiskRule` post-construction (immutable).\n- **BR-3 Cross-currency forbidden**: `Money` arithmetic across mixed currencies raises `CurrencyMismatchError` per Rule 5 + I-S6. Phase 1 = VND only.\n- **BR-4 Source attribution**: every `Bar` carries `source_provider`. Codifies the existing L-S11-1 doctrine (Phase 0 hooks must be bash + POSIX only) as a financial-data-protocol clause because hook portability is a precondition for the data-integrity rules in Rules 1-10.\n\n## Append to `financial-data-protocol.md` (NEW section)\n\n---\n\n## Rule 11 — Hook Portability Per Phase\n\nThe data-integrity hooks in `scripts/hooks/` (telemetry, drift signals, learning-data sweepers, citation grep) enforce Rules 1-10. They must remain portable across phase boundaries so a fresh project clone reproduces the same enforcement without external toolchain installation.\n\n### Phase 0 (Harness Bootstrap) — bash + POSIX only\n\nDuring Phase 0, hooks MUST use bash + POSIX utilities only. Forbidden: `python`/`python3`, `jq`/`yq`, `pip`/`npm`/`pnpm`. Reason: a fresh user cloning the repo at Phase 0 has not yet provisioned a Python venv or jq install; hook failures at SessionStart create a worse first impression than no hook.\n\n**Enforcement**: `scripts/hooks/bash-hook-lint.sh § Check 1 L-S11-1` scans `scripts/hooks/*.sh` and soft-warns on any non-Phase-0-portable invocation.\n\n### Phase 1+ (Data Pipeline Active) — Python + jq accepted\n\nOnce Phase 1 ships the Python venv + data dependencies (`pyproject.toml` provisioned), hooks may invoke Python and jq. The bash-hook-lint check downgrades L-S11-1 to informational severity at phase boundary (config flag: `STOCKFORGE_HOOK_PORTABILITY_TIER=1`).\n\n### Why This Matters for Financial Data Integrity\n\nA Phase 0 hook that depends on jq for JSON parsing fails silently when jq is missing. Silent hook failure = drift signal not firing = data-integrity violation goes undetected. The portability rule is upstream of every Rule 1-10 enforcement.\n\n**Concrete example**: D9 drift signal (runtime-path-leak into `learning-data/(events|archive)/`) is critical for Rule 6 (LLM Output Provenance) — if D9 hook fails to run because of a missing dependency, runtime code can silently load write-only telemetry into reasoning context, polluting decisions with non-runtime data.\n\n## End of amendment\n","numLines":43,"startLine":1,"totalLines":43}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"8a9f0fe8-5ee3-4b1d-a97e-9fe0025c8c18","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"e2287e94-1acd-4b20-9e3c-c3aa9e945ed8","version":"2.1.123","gitBranch":"main"}

Investment here pays 10x later.\n6\t\n7\t---\n8\t\n9\t## Phase A — Understand the Vision (90-120 min)\n10\t\n11\t### A.1 Read Project Charter\n12\t**File**: `PROJECT_CHARTER.md`\n13\t**Time**: 30 min\n14\t**Why**: Immutable vision. Everything flows from this. If you disagree with something, revise the charter now — it's much harder later.\n15\t\n16\t- [ ] Read all sections\n17\t- [ ] Understand the **Four-Tier Signal Architecture** (core insight)\n18\t- [ ] Confirm you agree with Core Principles (non-negotiable)\n19\t- [ ] Confirm you agree with Honest Boundaries (what system does NOT do)\n20\t- [ ] Confirm Success Criteria feel achievable for your life circumstances\n21\t\n22\t### A.2 Read Strategic Signal Architecture Spec\n23\t**File**: `specs/tier1-strategic/001-four-tier-signal-architecture.md`\n24\t**Time**: 30-40 min\n25\t**Why**: This is the single most important architectural document. Every other spec builds on it.\n26\t\n27\t- [ ] Understand each tier's role, lead time, and reliability profile\n28\t- [ ] Understand the combinatorial patterns (early opportunity, likely top, manufactured pump, forgotten value)\n29\t- [ ] Understand why single-tier approaches fail for VN market\n30\t\n31\t### A.3 Skim Agent Operating Manual\n32\t**File**: `AGENT_OPERATING_MANUAL.md`\n33\t**Time**: 30-40 min\n34\t**Why**: Understand how agents operate.\n35\t\n36\tFocus sections:\n37\t- [ ] Section 1 — Mental Model\n38\t- [ ] Section 2 — Workspace Architecture\n39\t- [ ] Section 3 — Obsidian Integration\n40\t- [ ] Section 5 — Skills Catalog (skim)\n41\t- [ ] Section 10 — Session Protocols\n42\t\n43\t### A.4 Read Financial Data Protocol\n44\t**File**: `agent-workspace/constitution/financial-data-protocol.md`\n45\t**Time**: 20 min\n46\t**Why**: Stock-specific data integrity rules. Read carefully — these rules prevent real money loss.\n47\t\n48\t- [ ] Understand point-in-time integrity (look-ahead bias)\n49\t- [ ] Understand survivorship bias awareness\n50\t- [ ] Understand No-LLM-Math rule (I-S1)\n51\t- [ ] Understand source attribution and reconciliation\n52\t- [ ] Acknowledge: backtest discipline is non-negotiable\n53\t\n54\t### A.5 Read Constitution Invariants\n55\t**File**: `agent-workspace/constitution/invariants.md`\n56\t**Time**: 15 min\n57\t\n58\t- [ ] Focus on stock-specific invariants (I-S1 through I-S54)\n59\t- [ ] Understand severity levels\n60\t- [ ] Understand violation handling\n61\t\n62\t---\n63\t\n64\t## Phase B — Prepare Your Context (60-90 min)\n65\t\n66\t### B.1 Customize Financial Data Protocol\n67\t\n68\t**File**: `agent-workspace/constitution/financial-data-protocol.md`\n69\t\n70\tAdjust if needed (but rarely):\n71\t- [ ] Risk tolerance parameters (if any reference)\n72\t- [ ] Budget caps (if different from defaults)\n73\t\n74\t### B.2 Seed Historical Theses\n75\t\n76\tCreate `eval-sets/historical-theses/seed.md` with 5 stocks you've watched and what you'd have done:\n77\t\n78\t- [ ] Pick 5 stocks you have strong opinions on (real experience)\n79\t- [ ] For each: ticker, as-of date, would you have bought/avoided, why, what happened\n80\t- [ ] This becomes initial eval set for measuring system quality\n81\t\n82\tExample:\n83\t```markdown\n84\t## HPG — 2023-01-01\n85\t**My call**: AVOID\n86\t**Why**: High leverage, steel cycle uncertain, governance mediocre\n87\t**What happened**: Stock went up 30% by year-end\n88\t**My call was**: WRONG (missed cyclical recovery + inventory restock)\n89\t**Lesson**: Don't confuse fundamental concerns with timing. Cycle timing mattered more.\n90\t```\n91\t\n92\t### B.3 Seed KOL List\n93\t\n94\tCreate `eval-sets/labeled-kol-recommendations/seed-kols.md` with 10 Vietnamese finance KOLs you know:\n95\t\n96\t- [ ] List 10 KOLs by name + primary channel URL\n97\t- [ ] For each: YouTube/FB/Telegram, your gut estimate of quality\n98\t- [ ] Notes: sectors they cover, style (fundamental/technical/narrative), any known bias\n99\t\n100\tExample:\n101\t```markdown\n102\t## KOL: [Channel Name]\n103\t- Platform: YouTube\n104\t- URL: https://youtube.com/@...\n105\t- Est subscribers: 150K\n106\t- Style: Mixed fundamental+narrative\n107\t- Sectors: Banking, real estate\n108\t- Gut credibility (before calibration): 6/10\n109\t- Notes: Often reacts to mainstream news rather than leads\n110\t```\n111\t\n112\t### B.4 Seed Historical Pumps\n113\t\n114\tCreate `eval-sets/labeled-pumps/seed.md` with 3-5 pumps you remember:\n115\t\n116\t- [ ] Ticker + approx dates\n117\t- [ ] What you remember about the cycle\n118\t- [ ] Eventual outcome\n119\t\n120\tExample:\n121\t```markdown\n122\t## FLC Group — 2021-11 to 2022-01\n123\t**Type**: Coordinated pump by connected parties\n124\t**Narrative**: \"real estate boom + cryptocurrency tie-in\"\n125\t**Peak phase**: Dec 2021, massive volume + FOMO posts on forums\n126\t**Dump**: Jan 2022 after 77 TPS trading violations exposed\n127\t**Subsequent outcome**: Multi-year trading halt, eventual delisting\n128\t**My observation**: [what you noticed at the time]\n129\t```\n130\t\n131\t### B.5 Define Personal Risk Profile\n132\t\n133\tCreate `agent-workspace/memory/personal-risk-profile.md`:\n134\t\n135\t- [ ] Holding period preference (months/years)\n136\t- [ ] Position sizing rules (max % per stock, max % per sector)\n137\t- [ ] Stop-loss philosophy (thesis-invalidation vs percentage)\n138\t- [ ] Dividend preference\n139\t- [ ] Sector exclusions (if any — e.g., \"never BĐS during credit tightening\")\n140\t- [ ] Maximum portfolio drawdown tolerance\n141\t\n142\t---\n143\t\n144\t## Phase C — Environment Setup (60-90 min)\n145\t\n146\t### C.1 Install Prerequisites\n147\t\n148\t- [ ] Claude Code: `claude --version` should work\n149\t- [ ] Python 3.11+: `python --version`\n150\t- [ ] Docker: `docker --version`\n151\t- [ ] Git: `git --version`\n152\t- [ ] Obsidian (optional but recommended for wiki browsing)\n153\t- [ ] DBeaver or similar DB client\n154\t\n155\t### C.2 Set Up Local Infrastructure\n156\t\n157\t- [ ] Copy `.env.example` to `.env` and fill in:\n158\t  - Investment here pays 10x later.\n\n---\n\n## Phase A — Understand the Vision (90-120 min)\n\n### A.1 Read Project Charter\n**File**: `PROJECT_CHARTER.md`\n**Time**: 30 min\n**Why**: Immutable vision. Everything flows from this. If you disagree with something, revise the charter now — it's much harder later.\n\n- [ ] Read all sections\n- [ ] Understand the **Four-Tier Signal Architecture** (core insight)\n- [ ] Confirm you agree with Core Principles (non-negotiable)\n- [ ] Confirm you agree with Honest Boundaries (what system does NOT do)\n- [ ] Confirm Success Criteria feel achievable for your life circumstances\n\n### A.2 Read Strategic Signal Architecture Spec\n**File**: `specs/tier1-strategic/001-four-tier-signal-architecture.md`\n**Time**: 30-40 min\n**Why**: This is the single most important architectural document. Every other spec builds on it.\n\n- [ ] Understand each tier's role, lead time, and reliability profile\n- [ ] Understand the combinatorial patterns (early opportunity, likely top, manufactured pump, forgotten value)\n- [ ] Understand why single-tier approaches fail for VN market\n\n### A.3 Skim Agent Operating Manual\n**File**: `AGENT_OPERATING_MANUAL.md`\n**Time**: 30-40 min\n**Why**: Understand how agents operate.\n\nFocus sections:\n- [ ] Section 1 — Mental Model\n- [ ] Section 2 — Workspace Architecture\n- [ ] Section 3 — Obsidian Integration\n- [ ] Section 5 — Skills Catalog (skim)\n- [ ] Section 10 — Session Protocols\n\n### A.4 Read Financial Data Protocol\n**File**: `agent-workspace/constitution/financial-data-protocol.md`\n**Time**: 20 min\n**Why**: Stock-specific data integrity rules. Read carefully — these rules prevent real money loss.\n\n- [ ] Understand point-in-time integrity (look-ahead bias)\n- [ ] Understand survivorship bias awareness\n- [ ] Understand No-LLM-Math rule (I-S1)\n- [ ] Understand source attribution and reconciliation\n- [ ] Acknowledge: backtest discipline is non-negotiable\n\n### A.5 Read Constitution Invariants\n**File**: `agent-workspace/constitution/invariants.md`\n**Time**: 15 min\n\n- [ ] Focus on stock-specific invariants (I-S1 through I-S54)\n- [ ] Understand severity levels\n- [ ] Understand violation handling\n\n---\n\n## Phase B — Prepare Your Context (60-90 min)\n\n### B.1 Customize Financial Data Protocol\n\n**File**: `agent-workspace/constitution/financial-data-protocol.md`\n\nAdjust if needed (but rarely):\n- [ ] Risk tolerance parameters (if any reference)\n- [ ] Budget caps (if different from defaults)\n\n### B.2 Seed Historical Theses\n\nCreate `eval-sets/historical-theses/seed.md` with 5 stocks you've watched and what you'd have done:\n\n- [ ] Pick 5 stocks you have strong opinions on (real experience)\n- [ ] For each: ticker, as-of date, would you have bought/avoided, why, what happened\n- [ ] This becomes initial eval set for measuring system quality\n\nExample:\n```markdown\n## HPG — 2023-01-01\n**My call**: AVOID\n**Why**: High leverage, steel cycle uncertain, governance mediocre\n**What happened**: Stock went up 30% by year-end\n**My call was**: WRONG (missed cyclical recovery + inventory restock)\n**Lesson**: Don't confuse fundamental concerns with timing. Cycle timing mattered more.\n```\n\n### B.3 Seed KOL List\n\nCreate `eval-sets/labeled-kol-recommendations/seed-kols.md` with 10 Vietnamese finance KOLs you know:\n\n- [ ] List 10 KOLs by name + primary channel URL\n- [ ] For each: YouTube/FB/Telegram, your gut estimate of quality\n- [ ] Notes: sectors they cover, style (fundamental/technical/narrative), any known bias\n\nExample:\n```markdown\n## KOL: [Channel Name]\n- Platform: YouTube\n- URL: https://youtube.com/@...\n- Est subscribers: 150K\n- Style: Mixed fundamental+narrative\n- Sectors: Banking, real estate\n- Gut credibility (before calibration): 6/10\n- Notes: Often reacts to mainstream news rather than leads\n```\n\n### B.4 Seed Historical Pumps\n\nCreate `eval-sets/labeled-pumps/seed.md` with 3-5 pumps you remember:\n\n- [ ] Ticker + approx dates\n- [ ] What you remember about the cycle\n- [ ] Eventual outcome\n\nExample:\n```markdown\n## FLC Group — 2021-11 to 2022-01\n**Type**: Coordinated pump by connected parties\n**Narrative**: \"real estate boom + cryptocurrency tie-in\"\n**Peak phase**: Dec 2021, massive volume + FOMO posts on forums\n**Dump**: Jan 2022 after 77 TPS trading violations exposed\n**Subsequent outcome**: Multi-year trading halt, eventual delisting\n**My observation**: [what you noticed at the time]\n```\n\n### B.5 Define Personal Risk Profile\n\nCreate `agent-workspace/memory/personal-risk-profile.md`:\n\n- [ ] Holding period preference (months/years)\n- [ ] Position sizing rules (max % per stock, max % per sector)\n- [ ] Stop-loss philosophy (thesis-invalidation vs percentage)\n- [ ] Dividend preference\n- [ ] Sector exclusions (if any — e.g., \"never BĐS during credit tightening\")\n- [ ] Maximum portfolio drawdown tolerance\n\n---\n\n## Phase C — Environment Setup (60-90 min)\n\n### C.1 Install Prerequisites\n\n- [ ] Claude Code: `claude --version` should work\n- [ ] Python 3.11+: `python --version`\n- [ ] Docker: `docker --version`\n- [ ] Git: `git --version`\n- [ ] Obsidian (optional but recommended for wiki browsing)\n- [ ] DBeaver or similar DB client\n\n### C.2 Set Up Local Infrastructure\n\n- [ ] Copy `.env.example` to `.env` and fill in:\n  - `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` (required)\n  - `OPENAI_API_KEY` (for embeddings)\n  - Database credentials (for docker-compose)\n- [ ] Run `docker-compose up -d` to start Postgres + Redis\n- [ ] Verify Postgres has TimescaleDB + pgvector extensions:\n  ```sql\n  CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS timescaledb;\n  CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;\n  CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_trgm;\n  ```\n\n### C.3 Verify Claude Code Integration\n\n- [ ] Open `stockforge/` in Claude Code: `cd stockforge && claude`\n- [ ] Type: `/session-start` — should load context successfully\n- [ ] Type: `/handoff-read` — should read memory files\n\n---\n\n## Phase D — First Agent Interactions (45-60 min)\n\n### D.1 Run First Drill-Me\n\nGoal: seed ubiquitous language for Vietnamese stock domain.\n\n```\n/drill-me \"Vietnam stock market value investing with KOL tracking\"\n```\n\nExpected output:\n- Proposed glossary terms (Ticker, Thesis, KOL, Credibility Score, Narrative Phase, etc.)\n- Q&A to clarify domain nuances\n- Final glossary saved to `agent-workspace/ubiquitous-language/glossary.md`\n\n- [ ] Complete drill-me session\n- [ ] Review output in glossary file\n- [ ] Adjust any terms that don't match your mental model\n\n### D.2 Master Plan for Phase 1\n\n```\n/master-plan \"implement Phase 1 thin slice — thesis validation for VN30 with Tier 1+2 data\"\n```\n\nExpected output:\n- Session plan files in `agent-workspace/session-plans/pending/`\n- Each session plan: clear scope, estimated tokens, success criteria\n\n- [ ] Review generated session plans\n- [ ] Adjust scope if too ambitious (smaller is fine)\n- [ ] Commit the plans to version control\n\n### D.3 Update current-execution.md\n\n- [ ] Update `agent-workspace/memory/current-execution.md`:\n  - Phase: 1 (Foundation)\n  - Active plan: path to first session plan from master-plan\n  - Status: ready\n\n---\n\n## Phase E — Commit & Baseline (30 T+2.5, Room ngoại, Sàn HOSE/HNX/UPCoM, Trần, Sàn, Phiên ATO/ATC, Tỷ giá USD/VND)\n  - specs/tier2-feature/000-phase-1-thin-slice-VHM.md § A.3 BR-3 + BR-5 (T+2.5 informational; VND only Phase 1)\n  - agent-workspace/constitution/financial-data-protocol.md Rules 1-10 (existing baseline; this amendment APPENDS Rules 12-15 — Rule 11 reserved for S16 amendment Hook Portability)\n  - docs/DAY_1_CHECKLIST.md § A.4 + § B.1 (financial-data-protocol customization step)\ntarget_constitution_path: agent-workspace/constitution/financial-data-protocol.md\ntarget_section: NEW § \"Vietnam-Domain Rules 12-15\"\nmove_when: user explicit approve; insertion point = after \"## Rule 10: Backtest Reproducibility\" and before \"## Quick Reference Table\"\nrelates_to:\n  - financial-data-protocol-amendment.md (S16 — Rule 11 Hook Portability; ORTHOGONAL to this amendment, NOT a fold)\n  - invariants-amendment-VN.md (S26 sibling — I-S55-I-S65 invariants enforce these Rules)\n---\n\n# Financial Data Protocol Amendment — Vietnam-Domain Rules 12-15\n\n> **Status**: PROPOSAL pending user approve. Codifies VN-specific data integrity rules that emerged from glossary v1.0 (S25) and Phase 1 thin-slice spec (S25). Each Rule names existing glossary terms by exact spelling and references invariants-amendment-VN.md for enforcement.\n>\n> **Why these Rules and not others**: glossary v1.0 surfaced 8 critical VN-domain terms (T+2.5, Room ngoại, Đội lái, Mua chủ động, Bán chủ động, Sàn HOSE/HNX/UPCoM, Phiên ATO/ATC, Tỷ giá USD/VND). Rules 12-15 cover the 4 that are data-integrity-binding for Phase 1+ (settlement timing, foreign-cap detection, sàn-tier data quality, FX point-in-time). Đội lái + Mua/Bán chủ động + ATO/ATC are Phase 2+ (intraday + Tier 4 work) — deferred.\n\n## Append to `financial-data-protocol.md` (NEW section, after Rule 10)\n\n---\n\n## Rule 12 — T+2.5 Settlement Timing Awareness\n\n### The Problem\n\nVN equities settle T+2.5 (trade date + 2.5 trading days). A buy on Monday clears Wednesday afternoon; cash from a Monday sell is re-investable Wednesday afternoon. Backtests that ignore T+2.5 over-count compoundable cash by 2-3 trading days, producing false-positive performance especially for high-turnover strategies.\n\n### The Rule\n\n- Every `Position` entity tracks `opened_at` = trade-match date (NOT cleared-cash date).\n- Every cash-flow record carries `cleared_at = opened_at + T+2.5 trading days` (computed via VN trading calendar, not naive +3 calendar days).\n- Backtest re-investment available cash queries: `WHERE cleared_at <= action_date`.\n- Live cash queries may use `cleared_at <= today` for pre-trade checks; cash gating in `apps/cli/order_*.py` (Phase 2+) MUST consult cleared cash, not trade-match cash.\n- Phase 1 thin-slice exception: `Position.opened_at` is required, but T+2.5 cash gating is NOT enforced (deferred to Phase 2 when intraday/order-management lands per spec 000 § BR-5).\n\n### The Enforcement\n\n`PositionRepository.compute_cleared_cash(as_of_date)` is the only path for re-investable cash. No `available_cash()` method bypasses T+2.5. CI gate (Phase 2+) adds property test: random portfolio + random sell timing, assert `cleared_at - opened_at` always ≥2.5 trading days per VN calendar.\n\n---\n\n## Rule 13 — Room Ngoại (Foreign-Ownership Cap) Detection\n\n### The Problem\n\nForeign investors face a hard ceiling on per-stock ownership in VN equities. The cap is sector-dependent: banking ≤30%, real estate ≤49%, most industrial ≤49% with stock-specific overrides. When a stock saturates Room ngoại, foreign buy-pressure cannot accumulate further — the stock is effectively closed to foreign-flow signal until domestic holders sell to foreigners. Strategies that key on \"foreign accumulation\" silently fail on saturated stocks. Strategies that pump on \"Room ngoại near full\" (early signal of further foreign demand) miss the regime.\n\n### The Rule\n\n- Every `Bar` (BC-1) carries `foreign_buy_volume` + `foreign_sell_volume` (existing schema per architecture.md BC-1).\n- NEW per-Ticker daily snapshot record `ForeignOwnershipState`: `(ticker, date, foreign_owned_shares, foreign_cap_shares, saturation_pct, source_provider, ingested_at, as_of)`.\n- `saturation_pct = foreign_owned_shares / foreign_cap_shares`. When `saturation_pct >= 0.95`, the stock is in saturation regime — foreign-flow analysis must explicitly mark this.\n- Source provenance: HOSE listed-stocks portal + vnstock `room_ngoai()` endpoint + TCBS reconciliation per Rule 4. Rule 4 reconciliation tolerance = 1% of cap (NOT 1% of saturation_pct — different denominators).\n- Backtest queries on foreign accumulation MUST filter `WHERE saturation_pct < 0.95 OR explicit_saturation_strategy = TRUE`.\n\n### The Enforcement\n\n`ForeignOwnershipRepository` Protocol: `get_state_as_of(ticker, as_of_date)` + `get_saturated_universe(as_of_date, threshold=0.95)`. Bar+ForeignOwnership join in `MarketDataReadModel` denormalized view. Phase 1 thin-slice on VHM does NOT seed ForeignOwnership data (Phase 2 deliverable when full VN30 ingestion lands); Bar.foreign_buy / foreign_sell fields are seeded but Saturation analysis deferred.\n\n---\n\n## Rule 14 — Sàn HOSE / HNX / UPCoM Data-Quality Tiering\n\n### The Problem\n\nVN listed equities split across 3 exchanges (Sàn): HOSE (HCMC; tier-1 large caps; strictest disclosure), HNX (Hanoi; tier-2; mid-caps), UPCoM (over-the-counter board; tier-3; micro-caps + pre-listing transitional). Data quality, filing cadence, and cross-source reconciliation tolerance differ by Sàn. Treating UPCoM Bars with the same trust as HOSE Bars produces false-positive backtest signals on noisy UPCoM data.\n\n### The Rule\n\n- Every `Ticker` value object infers Sàn at construction (regex on listing-status feed: 3-letter alpha → HOSE; 3-letter alpha + HNX flag → HNX; UPCoM has explicit ticker namespace).\n- Every `Bar` carries `sàn` field (NEW; values: HOSE | HNX | UPCoM). Field is denormalized from Ticker for query performance (Rule 4 reconciliation runs per-Sàn).\n- Reconciliation tolerance per Rule 4 is Sàn-tiered:\n  - HOSE: ±1% (existing tolerance preserved)\n  - HNX: ±2% (mid-cap, slightly noisier filings)\n  - UPCoM: ±5% (micro-cap, frequent stale data; Sàn-tier downgrade flag mandatory)\n- Phase 1 thin-slice scope locks to HOSE only (VHM is HOSE; spec 000 § A.5 Out-of-Scope item 4).\n- Charter \"First Sub-Scope\" mid-cap band (vốn hóa 2,000-50,000 tỷ VND) implicitly excludes most UPCoM stocks; this Rule codifies the data-quality reason.\n\n### The Enforcement\n\n`Bar.__post_init__` validates `sàn ∈ {HOSE, HNX, UPCoM}`. `ReconciliationService.tolerance_for(bar)` returns Sàn-tier tolerance. Backtest universe construction (per Rule 2) MUST tag `Sàn` per row; CI gate (Phase 2+) warns if backtest dataset mixes Sàn without explicit tier-aware logic.\n\n---\n\n## Rule 15 — FX VND-USD Point-in-Time Discipline\n\n### The Problem\n\nVN equities are priced VND. Some thesis comparisons reference USD-denominated peers (e.g., regional comparable PE). FX rates VND/USD drift 1-3% per quarter and 5-8% per year. A naive \"as_of FX rate\" lookup using today's rate to convert a 2024-Q1 metric distorts comparable analysis silently. Rule 5 already mandates explicit `Money.convert(target_currency, as_of_rate)`; Rule 15 codifies VN specifics and the FX rate source-attribution discipline.\n\n### The Rule\n\n- FX rates VND/USD (and any other pair) stored as `FxRate(currency_pair, as_of_date, rate, source_provider, ingested_at)` records per Rule 1 point-in-time integrity.\n- `source_provider` for FX MUST be one of: `SBV` (Tỷ giá trung tâm State Bank of Vietnam — official reference rate) | `VCB` (Vietcombank cash quote) | `VNSTOCK` (vnstock historical FX endpoint, derived from interbank). NEVER LLM-extracted (I-S1).\n- `Money.convert(target_currency, as_of_date)` resolves FX via `FxRateRepository.get_as_of(currency_pair, as_of_date)` — NOT current-day rate. If as_of_date pre-dates earliest stored FX rate, raise `FxRateNotAvailableError` (do NOT fallback to nearest); this preserves Rule 1 integrity at the FX layer.\n- Backtest cross-currency: every conversion call records `(amount_native, amount_target, fx_rate_used, fx_as_of_date, fx_source)` for audit reproducibility per Rule 10.\n- Phase 1 thin-slice: VND only (spec 000 § BR-3); FX subsystem stubbed but unused.\n\n### The Enforcement\n\n`Money.convert()` raises if FX rate unavailable for as_of_date. `FxRateRepository.get_as_of()` enforces point-in-time. CI test (Phase 2+): backtest with deliberate cross-currency comparison runs twice with same `(commit, snapshot, config, seed)` and produces identical converted values per Rule 10 reproducibility.\n\n---\n\n## Why Rules 12-15 Are Phase-1-Compatible Even Though Phase 1 Doesn't Enforce Them\n\nRules 12-15 are codified now to anchor S27-S28 entity design (Bar.sàn field, Position.opened_at semantics, FX placeholder structure) so Phase 2 enforcement layers slot into existing types without retrofitting. This matches Charter \"When in doubt, simplify\" + \"Ship thin slices\" — types are designed once, enforcement layers ship phase-by-phase.\n\n## End of amendment\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":1,"cache_creation_input_tokens":7212,"cache_read_input_tokens":166794,"output_tokens":4991,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":7212,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[{"input_tokens":1,"output_tokens":4991,"cache_read_input_tokens":166794,"cache_creation_input_tokens":7212,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":7212},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard"},"diagnostics":null},"requestId":"req_011CaZYh9w8j7uDXaEL1hxC1","type":"assistant","uuid":"b86ef492-2366-4a0b-b6e5-6b663547ad3c","timestamp":"2026-04-30T07:18:22.868Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"e2287e94-1acd-4b20-9e3c-c3aa9e945ed8","version":"2.1.123","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"50bb1d22-f5e4-472e-86f1-e927e9806d5c","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-7","id":"msg_012j8AkWXCUxBQ5TszHWiFvb","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01PBCPgqBiiCZkPYw8YQ9Wqr","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge\\agent-workspace\\proposals\\invariants-amendment-VN.md","content":"---\nstatus: PROPOSAL — AMENDMENT to existing agent-workspace/constitution/invariants.md\nproposed_at: 2026-04-30\nproposed_by: Claude Opus 4.7 (S26 IMPL — Phase 1 Track B; master-plan 004 § S26 deliverable #2)\nsource_evidence:\n  - PROJECT_CHARTER.md § First Sub-Scope (HOSE/HNX/UPCoM, position 5-15%, hold 1m+)\n  - agent-workspace/ubiquitous-language/glossary.md v1.0 (S25; 42 VN terms)\n  - agent-workspace/proposals/financial-data-protocol-amendment-VN.md (S26 sibling — Rules 12-15; these I-S* enforce those Rules)\n  - agent-workspace/constitution/invariants.md (existing I-S* baseline; last used I-S54; this amendment ships I-S55-I-S65)\n  - specs/tier2-feature/000-phase-1-thin-slice-VHM.md § A.3 BR-1..5 (informs which I-S* are Phase 1 binding)\ntarget_constitution_path: agent-workspace/constitution/invariants.md\ntarget_section: Append to ⭐ Stock-Specific Data Integrity (after I-S54 Calibration Drift Detection)\nmove_when: user explicit approve; insertion point = before \"## Code Integrity\"\nrelates_to:\n  - financial-data-protocol-amendment-VN.md (S26 sibling — Rules 12-15 enforced via these I-S55-I-S65)\nphase_binding_legend: \"Phase 1 = enforced now in code via dataclass __post_init__ or Protocol; Phase 2+ = scaffold + binding deferred until intraday/full-VN30/cash-mgmt land\"\n---\n\n# Invariants Amendment — Vietnam-Domain I-S55 through I-S65\n\n> **Status**: PROPOSAL pending user approve. 11 NEW stock-specific invariants enforcing financial-data-protocol-amendment-VN.md Rules 12-15. Each entry: ID + name + binding statement + enforcement + binding_phase.\n>\n> **Why 11 not 10**: master-plan 004 § S26 enumerated 11 distinct concerns (T+2.5 / foreign-room / ATO-ATC / dividend ex-date / listing-status / lot-size / ceiling-floor / suspension / ex-rights / reconciliation-tolerance / fallback-chain) — codified faithfully even though master-plan abstract count said \"10\". Better to ship 11 honestly than cherry-pick.\n\n## Append to `invariants.md` § ⭐ Stock-Specific Data Integrity (after I-S54)\n\n---\n\n### I-S55: T+2.5 Cleared Cash Re-Investability\n\nCash from a sell trade is re-investable only after T+2.5 trading days clear (VN settlement convention). Backtest re-investment logic must consult `Position.cleared_at`, not `opened_at`.\n\n**Enforcement**: `PositionRepository.compute_cleared_cash(as_of_date)` is the only path. `available_cash()` shortcut method forbidden. **Binding phase**: Phase 2 (when intraday + cash management land); Phase 1 thin-slice tracks `opened_at` only without cash gating per spec 000 § BR-5.\n\n### I-S56: Foreign-Room Saturation Alert\n\nWhen `ForeignOwnershipState.saturation_pct >= 0.95` for a Ticker, foreign-flow signal interpretation MUST explicitly mark saturation regime. Strategies keying on \"foreign accumulation\" silently fail on saturated stocks.\n\n**Enforcement**: `ForeignOwnershipRepository.get_saturated_universe(as_of_date)` returns Tickers with saturation ≥0.95. Alert pipeline (Phase 2+) emits `SaturationRegimeWarning` event before any foreign-flow-keyed signal is rendered. **Binding phase**: Phase 2 (full VN30 ingestion seeds ForeignOwnership data).\n\n### I-S57: Phiên ATO / ATC Phase Identification\n\nIntraday Bars from VN exchanges include Phiên ATO (At-The-Open auction; opening price discovery) + Phiên ATC (At-The-Close auction; closing price discovery). These auction-phase trades have non-continuous price formation; technical indicators that assume continuous trading misfire on ATO/ATC bars.\n\n**Enforcement**: Intraday Bar entity (Phase 2+) carries `phase ∈ {PRE_OPEN, ATO, CONTINUOUS, ATC, POST_CLOSE}`. Indicator calculations in BC-8 must filter or weight ATO/ATC bars per indicator semantics. **Binding phase**: Phase 2+ (Phase 1 thin-slice = EOD only; no intraday).\n\n### I-S58: Dividend Ex-Date Adjustment (VN Convention)\n\nVN dividends declare ex-date as last day stockholder is entitled to dividend (NOT first day price drops). Some sources report ex-date as next trading day. Mismatched ex-date → adjusted-price errors of 5-15% on dividend day.\n\n**Enforcement**: `DividendEvent` records `ex_date` (last-entitled day) + `pay_date` (cash distribution day) + `ex_date_source_convention ∈ {VN_LAST_ENTITLED, ALT_FIRST_DROP}`. Adjustment logic per Rule 3 always uses VN_LAST_ENTITLED + 1 trading day as the adjustment-effective date. Reconciliation between sources MUST normalize convention before comparison. **Binding phase**: Phase 1 (dataclass scaffold) + Phase 2 enforcement (when full corporate-actions feed lands).\n\n### I-S59: Listing-Status Sàn Tagging\n\nEvery Ticker carries `sàn ∈ {HOSE, HNX, UPCoM}` resolved at construction. Mixing Sàn in backtest universe without tier-aware logic is bug.\n\n**Enforcement**: `Ticker.__post_init__` validates `sàn` non-null. `Bar.sàn` denormalized from Ticker for query speed. Universe construction (per Rule 2) tags every row with `sàn`. CI warning (Phase 2+) when backtest dataset mixes Sàn without explicit tier handling. **Binding phase**: Phase 1 (scaffold + Bar field); Phase 2 enforcement.\n\n### I-S60: Lot-Size 100-Share Rule\n\nVN equities trade in lots of 100 shares (HOSE/HNX standard); odd-lot trades route to Sở giao dịch lô lẻ (separate market with different price discovery). Backtests that allow fractional or 1-share orders silently model unrealistic execution.\n\n**Enforcement**: `Order.quantity` validation: `quantity % 100 == 0` for round-lot path; `OddLotOrder` separate type for the lô lẻ path. Position-sizing (per Rule 11 risk-rule) rounds DOWN to nearest 100 shares. **Binding phase**: Phase 2 (when order management lands); Phase 1 Position quantity is informational only.\n\n### I-S61: Ceiling / Floor (Trần / Sàn) Per-Sàn Limits\n\nDaily price ceiling/floor (Trần/Sàn glossary terms) differ per Sàn: HOSE ±7%, HNX ±10%, UPCoM ±15% from prior reference price. Trades at ceiling/floor have non-continuous pricing (queue-based fills); backtest assumptions of continuous fillability fail.\n\n**Enforcement**: `Bar.is_at_ceiling()` + `is_at_floor()` methods (computed: `close == reference_price * (1 + sàn_limit_pct)` within rounding tolerance). Backtest fillability check (Phase 2+): if order price = ceiling/floor, model partial fill probability per Sàn. **Binding phase**: Phase 1 (Bar method scaffold) + Phase 2 fillability modeling.\n\n### I-S62: Trading-Suspension Event Handling\n\nVN exchanges suspend trading on individual Tickers (regulatory + compliance reasons; minutes to days to permanent). Backtests on suspended Tickers must skip or mark-to-last-trade (NOT extrapolate). Live thesis output on suspended stock must surface suspension status.\n\n**Enforcement**: `SuspensionEvent(ticker, started_at, ended_at_or_null, reason)` records. Bar query layer skips suspension windows for return calc; thesis output includes `suspension_status` field. **Binding phase**: Phase 2+ (suspension feed not in Phase 1 thin-slice).\n\n### I-S63: Corporate-Action Ex-Rights Tagging\n\nBeyond dividends + splits, VN corporate actions include rights issues (quyền mua), bonus shares (cổ phiếu thưởng), and capital adjustments. Ex-rights date carries adjustment math distinct from ex-dividend.\n\n**Enforcement**: `CorporateAction` aggregate covers `{DIVIDEND, SPLIT, RIGHTS_ISSUE, BONUS_SHARES, CAPITAL_ADJUSTMENT}`. Adjustment-type tagging per Rule 3 extended: `adjustment_type ∈ {NONE, DIVIDEND, SPLIT, BOTH, RIGHTS, BONUS, CAPITAL}`. **Binding phase**: Phase 1 enum scaffold + Phase 2 corporate-actions feed integration.\n\n### I-S64: vnstock vs TCBS Reconciliation Tolerance Sàn-Tiered\n\nPer Rule 14, reconciliation tolerance is Sàn-tiered: HOSE ±1%, HNX ±2%, UPCoM ±5%. Single tolerance across Sàn produces false-flag noise on UPCoM and missed-divergence on HOSE.\n\n**Enforcement**: `ReconciliationService.tolerance_for(bar)` returns Sàn-tier tolerance; existing `RECONCILIATION_TOLERANCE_PCT` constant DEPRECATED (kept for backward compat, raises DeprecationWarning). **Binding phase**: Phase 1 (S28 ReconciliationService implementation must consume `tolerance_for(bar)` from inception).\n\n### I-S65: Source-Fallback Chain Order\n\nWhen primary data source is unavailable, fallback chain is deterministic: vnstock → TCBS → Vietstock public → Manual. Manual override must document `override_reason` (per Rule 4). KOL-extracted numbers NEVER appear in this chain (I-S1 — no LLM math).\n\n**Enforcement**: `BarProvider.fetch_with_fallback(ticker, date_range)` consults chain in order; emits `SourceFallbackEvent` when non-primary source returned. Audit log records every fallback for Rule 10 reproducibility. **Binding phase**: Phase 1 (S28 vnstock primary + TCBS backup; Vietstock + Manual deferred Phase 2).\n\n---\n\n## Coverage Map: Rules 12-15 ↔ Invariants I-S55-I-S65\n\n| Rule | Enforced by |\n|---|---|\n| Rule 12 (T+2.5 settlement) | I-S55 cleared-cash re-investability |\n| Rule 13 (Room ngoại) | I-S56 foreign-room saturation alert |\n| Rule 14 (Sàn HOSE/HNX/UPCoM tiering) | I-S59 sàn tagging + I-S64 sàn-tier reconciliation |\n| Rule 15 (FX VND-USD point-in-time) | (covered by existing Rule 5 + I-S6; no new I-S* needed) |\n\nI-S57 (ATO/ATC), I-S58 (dividend ex-date), I-S60 (lot-size), I-S61 (ceiling/floor), I-S62 (suspension), I-S63 (ex-rights) anchor Phase 2 work on Bar/Order/CorporateAction types — codified now so Phase 2 enforcement slots into existing scaffolds.\n\n## End of amendment\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":1,"cache_creation_input_tokens":492,"cache_read_input_tokens":179057,"output_tokens":4841,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":492,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[{"input_tokens":1,"output_tokens":4841,"cache_read_input_tokens":179057,"cache_creation_input_tokens":492,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":492},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard"},"diagnostics":null},"requestId":"req_011CaZYot75YGU2p9Jw3wZtU","type":"assistant","uuid":"65be01be-1bca-4984-ba39-9c776889ccb0","timestamp":"2026-04-30T07:19:46.111Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"e2287e94-1acd-4b20-9e3c-c3aa9e945ed8","version":"2.1.123","gitBranch":"main"}

These auction-phase trades have non-continuous price formation; technical indicators that assume continuous trading misfire on ATO/ATC bars.\n\n**Enforcement**: Intraday Bar entity (Phase 2+) carries `phase ∈ {PRE_OPEN, ATO, CONTINUOUS, ATC, POST_CLOSE}`. Indicator calculations in BC-8 must filter or weight ATO/ATC bars per indicator semantics. **Binding phase**: Phase 2+ (Phase 1 thin-slice = EOD only; no intraday).\n\n### I-S58: Dividend Ex-Date Adjustment (VN Convention)\n\nVN dividends declare ex-date as last day stockholder is entitled to dividend (NOT first day price drops). Some sources report ex-date as next trading day. Mismatched ex-date → adjusted-price errors of 5-15% on dividend day.\n\n**Enforcement**: `DividendEvent` records `ex_date` (last-entitled day) + `pay_date` (cash distribution day) + `ex_date_source_convention ∈ {VN_LAST_ENTITLED, ALT_FIRST_DROP}`. Adjustment logic per Rule 3 always uses VN_LAST_ENTITLED + 1 trading day as the adjustment-effective date. Reconciliation between sources MUST normalize convention before comparison. **Binding phase**: Phase 1 (dataclass scaffold) + Phase 2 enforcement (when full corporate-actions feed lands).\n\n### I-S59: Listing-Status Sàn Tagging\n\nEvery Ticker carries `sàn ∈ {HOSE, HNX, UPCoM}` resolved at construction. Mixing Sàn in backtest universe without tier-aware logic is bug.\n\n**Enforcement**: `Ticker.__post_init__` validates `sàn` non-null. `Bar.sàn` denormalized from Ticker for query speed. Universe construction (per Rule 2) tags every row with `sàn`. CI warning (Phase 2+) when backtest dataset mixes Sàn without explicit tier handling. **Binding phase**: Phase 1 (scaffold + Bar field); Phase 2 enforcement.\n\n### I-S60: Lot-Size 100-Share Rule\n\nVN equities trade in lots of 100 shares (HOSE/HNX standard); odd-lot trades route to Sở giao dịch lô lẻ (separate market with different price discovery). Backtests that allow fractional or 1-share orders silently model unrealistic execution.\n\n**Enforcement**: `Order.quantity` validation: `quantity % 100 == 0` for round-lot path; `OddLotOrder` separate type for the lô lẻ path. Position-sizing (per Rule 11 risk-rule) rounds DOWN to nearest 100 shares. **Binding phase**: Phase 2 (when order management lands); Phase 1 Position quantity is informational only.\n\n### I-S61: Ceiling / Floor (Trần / Sàn) Per-Sàn Limits\n\nDaily price ceiling/floor (Trần/Sàn glossary terms) differ per Sàn: HOSE ±7%, HNX ±10%, UPCoM ±15% from prior reference price. Trades at ceiling/floor have non-continuous pricing (queue-based fills); backtest assumptions of continuous fillability fail.\n\n**Enforcement**: `Bar.is_at_ceiling()` + `is_at_floor()` methods (computed: `close == reference_price * (1 + sàn_limit_pct)` within rounding tolerance). Backtest fillability check (Phase 2+): if order price = ceiling/floor, model partial fill probability per Sàn. **Binding phase**: Phase 1 (Bar method scaffold) + Phase 2 fillability modeling.\n\n### I-S62: Trading-Suspension Event Handling\n\nVN exchanges suspend trading on individual Tickers (regulatory + compliance reasons; minutes to days to permanent). Backtests on suspended Tickers must skip or mark-to-last-trade (NOT extrapolate). Live thesis output on suspended stock must surface suspension status.\n\n**Enforcement**: `SuspensionEvent(ticker, started_at, ended_at_or_null, reason)` records. Bar query layer skips suspension windows for return calc; thesis output includes `suspension_status` field. **Binding phase**: Phase 2+ (suspension feed not in Phase 1 thin-slice).\n\n### I-S63: Corporate-Action Ex-Rights Tagging\n\nBeyond dividends + splits, VN corporate actions include rights issues (quyền mua), bonus shares (cổ phiếu thưởng), and capital adjustments. Ex-rights date carries adjustment math distinct from ex-dividend.\n\n**Enforcement**: `CorporateAction` aggregate covers `{DIVIDEND, SPLIT, RIGHTS_ISSUE, BONUS_SHARES, CAPITAL_ADJUSTMENT}`. Adjustment-type tagging per Rule 3 extended: `adjustment_type ∈ {NONE, DIVIDEND, SPLIT, BOTH, RIGHTS, BONUS, CAPITAL}`. **Binding phase**: Phase 1 enum scaffold + Phase 2 corporate-actions feed integration.\n\n### I-S64: vnstock vs TCBS Reconciliation Tolerance Sàn-Tiered\n\nPer Rule 14, reconciliation tolerance is Sàn-tiered: HOSE ±1%, HNX ±2%, UPCoM ±5%. Single tolerance across Sàn produces false-flag noise on UPCoM and missed-divergence on HOSE.\n\n**Enforcement**: `ReconciliationService.tolerance_for(bar)` returns Sàn-tier tolerance; existing `RECONCILIATION_TOLERANCE_PCT` constant DEPRECATED (kept for backward compat, raises DeprecationWarning). **Binding phase**: Phase 1 (S28 ReconciliationService implementation must consume `tolerance_for(bar)` from inception).\n\n### I-S65: Source-Fallback Chain Order\n\nWhen primary data source is unavailable, fallback chain is deterministic: vnstock → TCBS → Vietstock public → Manual. Manual override must document `override_reason` (per Rule 4). KOL-extracted numbers NEVER appear in this chain (I-S1 — no LLM math).\n\n**Enforcement**: `BarProvider.fetch_with_fallback(ticker, date_range)` consults chain in order; emits `SourceFallbackEvent` when non-primary source returned. Audit log records every fallback for Rule 10 reproducibility. **Binding phase**: Phase 1 (S28 vnstock primary + TCBS backup; Vietstock + Manual deferred Phase 2).\n\n---\n\n## Coverage Map: Rules 12-15 ↔ Invariants I-S55-I-S65\n\n| Rule | Enforced by |\n|---|---|\n| Rule 12 (T+2.5 settlement) | I-S55 cleared-cash re-investability |\n| Rule 13 (Room ngoại) | I-S56 foreign-room saturation alert |\n| Rule 14 (Sàn HOSE/HNX/UPCoM tiering) | I-S59 sàn tagging + I-S64 sàn-tier reconciliation |\n| Rule 15 (FX VND-USD point-in-time) | (covered by existing Rule 5 + I-S6; no new I-S* needed) |\n\nI-S57 (ATO/ATC), I-S58 (dividend ex-date), I-S60 (lot-size), I-S61 (ceiling/floor), I-S62 (suspension), I-S63 (ex-rights) anchor Phase 2 work on Bar/Order/CorporateAction types — codified now so Phase 2 enforcement slots into existing scaffolds.\n\n## End of amendment\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"65be01be-1bca-4984-ba39-9c776889ccb0","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"e2287e94-1acd-4b20-9e3c-c3aa9e945ed8","version":"2.1.123","gitBranch":"main"}
